advancements.orespawn_integrations.wonde: Hear the bar tell your story back to you, a size bigger than it happened.
Hear the mãe-da-lua cry at dusk, when the Unrecorded get up.
event.orespawn_integrations.dusk_cry.ord: The mãe-da-lua cried. The Unrecorded are up, and the King dreams of %s.
orespawn_integrations.almanaque.no_forec: No forecast. The sky hasn't made up its mind.
orespawn_integrations.almanaque.reason.t: on Thursdays the road is the Mula's
orespawn_integrations.gazette.claimed: Mailbox registered in your name. The quero-quero has been informed.
orespawn_integrations.gazette.dialog.tex: Gazette subscriptions, applicant. Free, at dawn, in your box.
orespawn_integrations.gazette.headline: %s: %s.
orespawn_integrations.gazette.joke.1: FOR SALE: Big Bertha, barely used, 24 swings. Ask for the Saci.
orespawn_integrations.gazette.lindalva: Out in the Sertão, Lindalva is already rhyming %s's story. Booklets once the press arrives.
orespawn_integrations.gazette.misfile.al: ALERT: everything in its place. The Treasury asks the public to remain calm.
orespawn_integrations.gazette.newcomer.0: Today: Monday. The court's day: bounties at the Lodge, and the week's law.
orespawn_integrations.gazette.newcomer.2: Today: Wednesday. Market day: it visits the best-kept house, or comes to see the baby.
orespawn_integrations.gazette.newcomer.3: Today: Thursday. Tonight, stay off the road: the Mula runs.
orespawn_integrations.gazette.newcomer.4: Today: Friday. The boteco shuts at midnight. Don't ask why.
orespawn_integrations.gazette.newcomer.5: Today: Saturday. Truco night: the boteco tells the week, bigger.
orespawn_integrations.gazette.newcomer.6: Today: Sunday. The forest rests: no animal Jade calls 'the Land's' today.
orespawn_integrations.gazette.odete.canc: Subscription cancelled. Form in triplicate. Come back tomorrow for the stamp.
orespawn_integrations.gazette.odete.no_p: Nothing on the rack for you, applicant. The paper comes at dawn.
orespawn_integrations.gazette.odete.rack: No mailbox on file. Your copies are here, applicant. All of them.
orespawn_integrations.gazette.odete.subs: Subscription registered. First copy at dawn, applicant. Not before.
orespawn_integrations.gazette.purses.emc: EMC: the Mint. That comes later.
orespawn_integrations.gazette.purses.eme: Emeralds: the vassals' change. Villagers and hunters.
orespawn_integrations.gazette.purses.rea: Reais: the Land's money. Tabs, market, the bar.
orespawn_integrations.gazette.purses.scr: Scraps: Treasury paper. Corrections, visas, caskets.
orespawn_integrations.senha.explainer_de: That one's explained tomorrow. Use it anyway.
orespawn_integrations.seu_ze.r18: The Mestre? He gives back what the King took. One gift at a time; it's a big debt.
orespawn_integrations.week.cc.almanac.fo: Tonight's overworld slot is booked for %s.
orespawn_integrations.week.cc.almanac.sh: Day %s: folklore %s, dish %s, dream %s, needle %s, Fall %s, night %s.
orespawn_integrations.week.cc.dawn: Dawn run by hand. The Land's day is now %s.
orespawn_integrations.week.cc.ledger: Dawn %s: %s jobs queued, %s run; slowest %s at %s µs; %s over 1 ms.
orespawn_integrations.week.cc.show: Land's day %s: %s (the game's day index reads %s).
week.orespawn_integrations.0: Monday. The Hunt's board is up.
week.orespawn_integrations.3: Thursday. Thursday into Friday, stay off the road.
week.orespawn_integrations.4: Friday. Tonight someone runs the fado: the seventh son's lot.
week.orespawn_integrations.5: Saturday. Truco tonight. Whatever you did, it's bigger now.
